transcript:
Header: 2026-11-03 15:00 PST - 45 minutes. Attendees: Sophie (Redwood AE), Ethan (Redwood SE), Priya (Redwood CSM), Daniel (HaloHealth Procurement), Marta (Halo Legal), Aisha (Halo Security), Ravi (Halo CTO - first 20m).

00:00 Sophie: hey everyone thanks for joining we'll kick off in a minute, um, thanks for carving out time. this is the procurement / legal onboarding to get the MSA and DPA across the finish line, and to make sure the SLAs and the security checklist are all aligned.
00:08 Daniel: thanks Sophie, yeah we've got Marta and Aisha here to go through the legal and security points. Ravi's on for the tech bits early.
00:15 Ravi: hi all, quick note from me — performance matters, particularly for our clinical routing. we'll be looking at 200-300ms p50 for short prompts and costs need to be reasonable.
00:26 Ethan: understood, we have the latency/throughput spreadsheet, we'll share the benchmarks vs our hosted and dedicated options. p50 and p95 numbers, and note on KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs that effect cost.
00:38 Marta: on the MSA we have five main redlines — liability caps, data residency clause, subprocessors list and right to audit, termination assistance, and also a carve-out for regulatory data. those are high level.
00:50 Sophie: okay, that's inline with what we've seen. we can go through each. liability cap — standard reedwood cap is 2x fees or $1M depending; we can run through options. do you have a preferred language?
01:02 Marta: we'd prefer a higher cap for regulated data, or alternatively carve out exceptions for breaches related to protected health information.
01:10 Sophie: noted. we'll propose a PHI carve-out and also present an alternate cap schedule in the redlines.
01:16 Aisha: on security — we need to confirm KMS options. we run keys in GCP KMS and use customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption. can Redwood support BYOK/HSM? also need how audit logs are surfaced — we need immutable audit logs for all inference requests tied to tokens.
01:31 Ethan: yes we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and Dedicated with VPC peering; for hosted we do offer a KMS integration path for enterprise customers. audit logs are available in the Console, and we can stream them to your SIEM (SPLUNK/Sumo/Cloud) — we'll include the retention and format in the checklist. couple caveats on hosted: certain lower-level telemetry is aggregated for performance reasons and may not be per-token in the same format as private.
01:58 Aisha: that's ok, as long as we can get request-level logs for PHI-processing flows. retention needs to be 7 years for certain audit trails.
02:06 Ethan: retention 7 years is long but doable for Dedicated / Private; for hosted we'll need to confirm storage model and costs — we'll call that out in the spreadsheet.
02:16 Marta: DPA — subprocessors list seems short, we need a full list and SOC2 report and ISO certs for the subprocessors. also want to see data flow diagrams.
02:29 Sophie: we'll attach current subprocessors and SOC2 Type II report. data flow diagram we'll have Priya pull from our securityDocs pack and send.
02:37 Priya: yup i'll assemble and send the package after this call.
02:40 Daniel: procurement timeline: we need final redlines by next week to make the approval meeting on Nov 17th. pricing has to be approved by finance; we already got preliminary pricing but need confirmation on committed capacity vs on-demand.
02:54 Sophie: thanks — to be explicit: we'll send updated MSA + DPA with suggested language by Nov 10, SE will provide benchmark and a recommended Dedicated sizing plan by Nov 6, and then we schedule legal-to-legal on week of Nov 15 if needed.
03:09 Marta: okay that timeline works. one technical question — we have a requirement that data never leave EU for certain customers. can we pin region and enforce residency?
03:17 Ethan: yes for Dedicated and Private we can pin region and in Hosted we support regional tenancy for enterprise customers. for strict residency we recommend Private deployment or a Dedicated pool in the EU region.
03:28 Aisha: also encryption in transit and at rest, TLS 1.2+, mTLS for service-to-service?
03:33 Ethan: mTLS and VPC peering supported for Dedicated and Private; hosted supports TLS and token-based auth with additional options for mTLS via private link in some cloud providers. we'll capture specifics.
03:45 Ravi: quick follow — do you do canary rollouts and automatic fallback to smaller models if capacity is constrained? we need graceful degradation for client-facing flows.
03:54 Ethan: yes, our routing supports fallback policies and canary rollouts; we'll include the rollout policy template. note that fallback to smaller models changes output quality — we'll show how we handle A/B and quality monitoring.
04:10 Marta: one redline in the DPA is on deletion windows — they want guaranteed deletion of customer data within 30 days on termination. can you commit to that?
04:19 Sophie: standard is 90 days across hosted tiers; for Dedicated/Private we can negotiate 30 days. we'll propose 30 days for Dedicated customers with an SLA.
04:29 Daniel: good to know. pricing question — finance asked what the uplift is to get Dedicated with BYOK and 7-year audit retention. ballpark?
04:38 Sophie: we'll put a line item in the quote; ballpark uplift is typically 25-40% depending on capacity and storage retention. we'll firm numbers in the quote-v3.
04:49 Marta: liability: also need indemnity language for third-party breaches caused by Redwood subprocessor.
04:55 Sophie: we can review indemnity language; our legal is open to limited indemnities tied to our negligence or willful misconduct, but we usually push back on broad third-party indemnities. we'll surface tradeoffs in redlines.
05:08 Aisha: on certifications — SOC2 Type II ok, do you have ISO 27001 and penetration test reports?
05:14 Sophie: SOC2 Type II is current, ISO 27001 is in progress (expected Q1 2027) — we'll share the latest pentest report and remediation notes.
05:24 Marta: okay. also want an explicit section on regulatory data handling for PHI and PII.
05:29 Sophie: we'll add PHI handling appendix and scoping note for healthcare customers.
05:34 Daniel: procurement internal path — after legal sign-off we need two week finance review and then exec signature. likely target to sign by end of November if redlines are returned on time.
05:45 Sophie: great. anything else on the tech front?
05:48 Ravi: nothing else, thanks.
05:50 Marta: one last item — subprocessors changes need 30 day notice? we prefer to have that in the DPA.
05:56 Ethan: we have a subprocessor notification cadence in the DPA, we'll confirm 30-day notice language and include the list.
06:04 Sophie: recap — Sophie send MSA/DPA redlines by Nov 10; Ethan sends benchmarks and Dedicated sizing by Nov 6; Priya sends security pack; Marta returns DPA comments by Nov 12; schedule legal-to-legal the week of Nov 15 if needed. any objections?
06:22 Daniel: no objections. thanks team.
06:25 Sophie: awesome, we'll follow up via email with the artifacts and next steps. thanks everyone.

Notes: transcription contains occasional mis-hearings; names spelled phonetically (e.g., reedwood vs Redwood in one auto transcription). references to docs and quote files were made and links will be posted in follow-up.
